_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard. A PlayStation project is a disc, or a program to run in place of one. The BIOS is not here: it is firmware, which the frontend resolves once and remembers, rather than something a project carries.

slots.title: Disc or program
slots.help: What the console runs. Usually a CD image: a .cue with the .bin files it names beside it, a .chd, a single .bin, .img or .iso of one data track, a PlayStation Store .pbp, or an .ecm. It can also be a PlayStation EXECUTABLE (.exe, .psexe, .ps-exe), which is what homebrew and test programs ship as: the tray stays empty and the console is handed the program once its own ROM has started.
